description: Creates a shape on a slide (batchUpdate createShape), optionally with its initial text in the same atomic batch. Types: text_box, rectangle, round_rectangle, ellipse, diamond, triangle, right_arrow, left_arrow, up_arrow, down_arrow, star, heart, cloud, callout — the API's other ~130 ShapeTypes go through batch_update. Position/size are in points ((0,0) is top-left; a default 16:9 slide is 720x405 pt); omitted geometry defaults to 300x80 pt at (50,50). Returns the shape's objectId in the reply. Fill/outline/shadow are not parameters here — style via batch_update updateShapeProperties; text styling via update_text_style.

object_id.description: Optional custom object id (5-50 chars of [a-zA-Z0-9_-:]); auto-generated when omitted.

page_object_id.description: The slide's object id to place the shape on (from list_slides).

presentation_id.description: The presentation id — the long id from the URL (docs.google.com/presentation/d/<presentationId>/edit) or from create_presentation output.

text.description: Initial text, inserted in the same atomic batch.

x_pt.description: Left edge in points (requires y_pt; default 50).

y_pt.description: Top edge in points (requires x_pt; default 50).

name: create_shape
title: Create a shape
